content.text: The Israel-Palestine conflict escalated on 7 October 2023 when Hamas, a Palestinian armed group and political movement based in the Gaza Strip, launched an attack on Israel, killing about 1,200 people and taking 251 hostages.
There would be a large surge in humanitarian aid entering Gaza.
Project Hope said the strike was 'a blatant violation of international humanitarian law, and a stark reminder that no one and no place is safe in Gaza'.
